_meta.note: Daytona HackSprint demo cache. All figures compiled from public market data on 2026-07-23 (post Q2 earnings crash). Verify price/PE on demo morning — they move daily.
_meta.sources: stockanalysis.com, Robinhood, fullratio.com, Yahoo Finance / StockStory, Motley Fool (2026-07-22~23)

why_it_fell_context.trigger: 2026-07-22 Q2 earnings: non-GAAP EPS $0.33 vs Wall St expectation $0.54 (big miss). Quarterly free cash flow turned NEGATIVE due to surging AI/robotics/robotaxi capex.
why_it_fell_context.but_also_true: Revenue $28.24B, +25.5% YoY (beat). Q2 deliveries 480,126, +25% YoY, an 18% beat vs consensus.
structural_worries: BYD retook global EV #1; Tesla US EV share fell from ~80% (2019) to ~44% (2025)
Volume growth achieved partly via price cuts -> auto margins compressing
Robotaxi/Optimus = huge spending today, no meaningful revenue yet (dedicated robotaxi fleet not expected until 2027+)
Analysts cut price targets after the miss; CFO guided capex to stay above $25B and grow for 2-3 more years
why_it_fell_context.parent_translation_plain: The store did record business — more cars sold than ever. But the company is spending far more on robots and self-driving than it earns, so this quarter it ended up with less money than it started with. That is why the price fell more than 13% in one day — if you had $10,000 in it, it became about $8,650 overnight.
